equipment.name: Transmission Electron Microscope (TEM)

equipment.name: Ultra-pure water (UPW) system
equipment.specifications: Supplies nano-grade water below measurement limits of 15 parts per trillion of boron, less than 225 parts per trillion of total oxidizable carbon (TOC), and less than 1 part per billion of dissolved oxygen.
